children.text: Waking Up and Realizing the Duty

children.speaker: Mum
children.cn: 彼得！快起床！你要迟到了！
children.notes: get up 意为“起床”；be late 意为“迟到”。
children.statement: 这句话包含两个祈使句和一个陈述句。
children.explanation: Peter! Get up! 是动词原形开头的祈使句，You're late! 是陈述句。

children.speaker: Peter
children.notes: What time is it? 是询问具体时间的常用句型。
children.statement: 这个疑问句用于询问具体的时间点。
children.explanation: What time is it? 是常用问时间的句型，相当于 What's the time?

children.speaker: Mum
children.notes: a quarter past six 相当于 6:15。
children.statement: a quarter past six 意为“六点四十五分”。
children.explanation: past 意为“过”，a quarter past six 是六点过一刻，即 6:15。

children.speaker: Peter
children.text: It's too early! School is at eight.
children.notes: too early 太早；School is at... 学校在……上学/上课。
children.statement: 句中的 too 表示“也”。
children.explanation: 此处的 too 是副词，意为“太；过于”。

children.speaker: Mum
children.notes: on duty 意为“值日；值班”。
children.statement: on duty 在句中意为“值日”。
children.explanation: on duty 意为值日或当值。

children.speaker: Peter
children.notes: Oh, no! 表达沮丧、惊慌的感叹语。
children.statement: Peter 此时意识到自己要迟到了。
children.explanation: Peter 叫喊“Oh, no! I'm late!”表明他很慌张。

children.speaker: Mum
children.text: Quickly! There's no time for a shower. Get dressed and go.
children.cn: 快点！没时间洗淋浴了。穿好衣服快走吧。
children.notes: there's no time for... 没时间做……；get dressed 穿好衣服。
children.statement: 妈妈让 Peter 先洗个澡再走。
children.explanation: 妈妈说的是“There's no time for a shower.（没时间洗淋浴了）”。

children.speaker: Peter
children.text: I can still brush my teeth.
children.notes: brush one's teeth 刷牙；teeth 是 tooth 的复数。
children.statement: teeth 是名词 tooth 的单数形式。
children.explanation: teeth 是复数形式，其单数是 tooth。

children.speaker: Mum
children.text: And here's your breakfast. Take it to school.
children.cn: 还有，这是你的早餐。带去学校吃。
children.notes: here's = here is 倒装结构；take... to... 带……去……
children.statement: 妈妈让 Peter 在家里慢慢吃完早餐。
children.explanation: 妈妈说“Take it to school（带去学校吃）”。

children.speaker: Peter
children.notes: 日常道谢与告别表达。
children.statement: 这是 Peter 感谢妈妈并说再见的话。
children.explanation: Peter 礼貌道谢并道别。

children.speaker: Mum
children.notes: 祈使句，表示祝愿或叮嘱，意为“注意安全”。
children.statement: Be safe 是形容词 safe 构成的祈使句。
children.explanation: Be 动词原形开头，safe 为形容词，意为注意安全。

children.cn: 对话2：学校里的早晨日常交流

children.speaker: Han Lin
children.text: Why are you at school so early, Peter? It's only seven o'clock.
children.cn: 彼得，你怎么这么早到校？才七点钟呢。
children.notes: Why 引导特殊疑问句询问原因；only 意为“只，仅仅”。
children.statement: 此时的时间是早上七点钟。
children.explanation: 句子明确说明“It's only seven o'clock”。

children.speaker: Peter
children.text: I'm on duty today. You're here early too, Han Lin!
children.cn: 我今天值日。韩林，你来得也很早啊！
children.notes: on duty 值日；too 意为“也”，置于句末。
children.statement: Peter 来得早是因为他今天值日。
children.explanation: Peter 回答“I'm on duty today”。

children.speaker: Han Lin
children.text: I like to do some reading before class. What time do you usually get up?
children.cn: 我喜欢在上课前读会儿书。你平时几点起床？
children.notes: do some reading 读读书；before class 上课前；What time 问具体时间。
children.statement: Han Lin 来得早是因为他喜欢课前阅读。
children.explanation: Han Lin 说明“I like to do some reading before class”。

children.speaker: Peter
children.notes: half past six = 6:30。
children.statement: half past six 表示的时间是六点半。
children.explanation: half past 意为“半点过后”，即 6:30。

children.speaker: Han Lin
children.notes: When 询问时间，have breakfast 吃早餐。
children.statement: When 在此句中引导特殊疑问句。
children.explanation: When 引导对时间的特殊疑问句。

children.speaker: Peter
children.text: At ten to seven. Before that, I brush my teeth and take a shower.
children.cn: 差十分七点（六点五十）。在那之前，我刷牙并洗淋浴。
children.notes: ten to seven = 6:50；take a shower 洗淋浴。
children.statement: Peter 在吃早餐之前会刷牙和洗澡。
children.explanation: Peter 说“Before that, I brush my teeth and take a shower”。

children.speaker: Han Lin
children.text: Oh, I usually take a shower at night.
children.notes: usually 通常；at night 在晚上。
children.statement: Han Lin 习惯在早晨洗淋浴。
children.explanation: Han Lin 说的是“I usually take a shower at night（在晚上）”。

children.speaker: Peter
children.text: Really? My family take showers in the morning.
children.cn: 真的吗？我们全家人都是早上洗淋浴的。
children.notes: family 在此指“家庭成员”，作复数；in the morning 在早晨。
children.statement: 句中 family 看作复数，谓语动词用了 take 原形。
children.explanation: 当 family 强调家庭成员全体时，谓语动词常用复数。

tree.cn: 校园小记者陆佳琪采访汤姆

children.speaker: Lu Jiaqi
children.text: Hi! I'm Lu Jiaqi, a school reporter. What's your name?
children.cn: 你好！我是校报记者陆佳琪。你叫什么名字？
children.notes: school reporter 校园记者。
children.statement: 陆佳琪是一名校园记者。
children.explanation: 陆佳琪自我介绍“I'm Lu Jiaqi, a school reporter”。

children.speaker: Tom
children.notes: 简单回答自己的名字。
children.statement: 受访者的名字是 Tom。
children.explanation: 受访者回答其名字为 Tom。

children.speaker: Lu Jiaqi
children.text: So Tom, what time do you usually get up?
children.cn: 那么汤姆，你通常几点起床？
children.notes: So 用作过渡连词，意为“那么”；usually 频度副词，意为“通常”。
children.statement: what time 用于询问具体的时间。
children.explanation: what time 常用来询问钟点等具体时间点。

children.speaker: Tom
children.cn: 差一刻七点（六点四十五）。
children.notes: a quarter to seven = 6:45。
children.statement: Tom 起床的时间是 7:15。
children.explanation: a quarter to seven 是差一刻到七点，即 6:45。

children.speaker: Lu Jiaqi
children.notes: And then 用于承上启下，询问接下来做的事情。
children.statement: And then 表示“接下来；然后”。
children.explanation: then 意为“然后，接着”，And then 是口语常用追问表达。

children.speaker: Tom
children.text: I have breakfast at about ten past seven. Then I go to school at ten to eight.
children.cn: 我在大约七点十分吃早餐。然后我在七点五十去上学。
children.notes: ten past seven = 7:10；ten to eight = 7:50；Then 作为副词表示先后顺序。
children.statement: Tom 在 7:50 去上学。
children.explanation: ten to eight 是差十分八点，即 7:50。

children.cn: 下午放学、晚间安排与就寝

children.speaker: Lu Jiaqi
children.notes: go home 回家，home 为副词，前面不加介词 to。
children.statement: go home 中的 home 前面需要加介词 to。
children.explanation: home 在此为副词，前面不需要介词 to。

children.speaker: Tom
children.notes: Around 意为“大约，在……左右”。
children.statement: Around five 表示大约五点钟。
children.explanation: around 在这里表示“大约”。

children.speaker: Lu Jiaqi
children.text: What do you do after that?
children.notes: after that 在那之后。
children.statement: after that 在句中作时间状语。
children.explanation: after that 意为“在那之后”，修饰整个句子的时间。
children.keywords: what do you do, after that

children.speaker: Tom
children.text: Sometimes I play basketball. I have dinner at half past six. Then I do my homework.
children.cn: 有时我打篮球。我在六点半吃晚饭。然后我做家庭作业。
children.notes: play basketball 打篮球；half past six = 6:30；do one's homework 做作业。
children.statement: Tom 每天吃完晚饭后打篮球。
children.explanation: Tom 是在晚饭前打篮球，饭后做作业（Then I do my homework）。

children.speaker: Lu Jiaqi
children.text: When do you usually go to bed?
children.cn: 你通常什么时候上床睡觉？
children.notes: go to bed 上床睡觉。
children.statement: go to bed 是固定短语，表示“上床睡觉”。
children.explanation: go to bed 意为就寝、上床睡觉。

children.speaker: Tom
children.notes: half past nine = 9:30。
children.statement: Tom 晚上九点半睡觉。
children.explanation: half past nine 对应 9:30。

children.speaker: Lu Jiaqi
children.notes: 感叹句简略形式，表示赞赏或惊奇。
children.statement: Lu Jiaqi 觉得九点半睡觉算比较晚。
children.explanation: Lu Jiaqi 感叹道“That's early!（那挺早的！）”。

children.speaker: Tom
children.text: Well, you know the saying, 'Early to bed, early to rise!'
children.cn: 嗯，你知道那句俗话：‘早睡早起！’
children.notes: saying 谚语；Early to bed, early to rise 早睡早起身体好（谚语）。
children.statement: “Early to bed, early to rise”是一句关于健康作息的谚语。
children.explanation: 这是英语经典谚语，强调早睡早起的好处。

children.notes: 自我介绍常用句型。
children.statement: 主人公的名字叫 Timo Halla。
children.explanation: 文中明确写明“My name is Timo Halla”。

children.notes: 表达年龄结构：... years old。
children.statement: Timo 现在的年龄是14岁。
children.explanation: 句中写的是“I'm 13 years old”。

children.text: I live with my parents in Helsinki, Finland.
children.cn: 我和父母住在芬兰赫尔辛基。
children.notes: live with 和……住在一起；Helsinki 赫尔辛基；Finland 芬兰。
children.statement: 赫尔辛基是芬兰的城市。
children.explanation: Helsinki 是芬兰的首都。

children.notes: December 十二月，注意首字母大写。
children.statement: 此时文章设定的月份是十二月。
children.explanation: 句中说“Now it's December”。

children.text: Every Tuesday, I usually get up at 7:40.
children.notes: Every Tuesday 每周二；usually 频度副词放在实义动词前。
children.statement: Timo 每周二早上 7:40 起床。
children.explanation: 文中写明“usually get up at 7:40”。

children.text: I often listen to the news or music.
children.notes: listen to 听……；or 连接两个并列名词。
children.statement: listen 是及物动词，后面可以直接接宾语 the news。
children.explanation: listen 是不及物动词，接宾语时必须带介词 to。

children.text: Going to School and Morning Lessons
After breakfast, I walk to school.
children.cn: 吃完早饭后，我步行去上学。
children.notes: After breakfast 介词短语作状语；walk to school 步行上学。
children.statement: After breakfast 意思是“早餐后”。
children.explanation: after 为介词，意为“在……之后”。

children.notes: 10-minute 复合形容词修饰 walk（名词，意为步行路程）。
children.statement: 这里的 walk 是动词用法。
children.explanation: 前面有冠词 a 和形容词修饰，这里的 walk 是名词，意为“步行路程”。

children.notes: begins 一般现在时第三人称单数形式。
children.statement: Timo 的学校在早上九点上课。
children.explanation: 句子明确说明“begins at 9:00”。

children.text: There are 18 students in my class.
children.notes: There are 表存在，后接复数名词 students。
children.statement: Timo 的班级一共有 28 名学生。
children.explanation: 句中为 18（eighteen）名学生。

children.text: Each lesson is 45 minutes long, and there's a break between lessons.
children.cn: 每节课45分钟，课间有休息。
children.notes: each lesson 每一节课；break 课间休息；between 两者之间。
children.statement: 芬兰学校课与课之间没有休息时间。
children.explanation: 句中明确写道“there's a break between lessons（课间有休息）”。

children.text: I have one Finnish lesson and two home economics lessons in the morning.
children.cn: 上午我有一节芬兰语课和两节家政课。
children.notes: Finnish 芬兰语；home economics 家政学/家庭经济学。
children.statement: Timo 周二上午有两节芬兰语课。
children.explanation: 原文是一节芬兰语课（one Finnish lesson）和两节家政课（two home economics lessons）。

children.cn: 午餐、下午课程与冰球活动

children.text: After that, I have lunch at 12:00.
children.notes: After that 作时间状语，have lunch 吃午饭。
children.statement: Timo 在中午十二点吃午餐。
children.explanation: 文中写明“have lunch at 12:00”。

children.text: The afternoon lessons begin at 12:30 and finish at 2:15.
children.notes: begin 开始；finish 结束。
children.statement: 下午的课程在 2:15 结束。
children.explanation: 句中说“finish at 2:15”。

children.text: Then I go to my ice hockey club.
children.cn: 然后我去我的冰球俱乐部。
children.notes: ice hockey 冰球运动；club 俱乐部。
children.statement: Timo 放学后去参加冰球俱乐部活动。
children.explanation: 句中说明“Then I go to my ice hockey club”。

children.notes: get home 到家；around 介词，大约。
children.statement: Timo 通常在下午四点左右到家。
children.explanation: 文中提到“get home around 4:00”。

children.notes: already 已经；dark 黑暗的；outside 外面。
children.statement: 芬兰十二月下午四点时外面通常天已经黑了。
children.explanation: 文中说明“It's already dark outside”，符合北欧冬季昼短夜长的特点。

children.notes: often 经常；have dinner 吃晚餐。
children.statement: Timo 常在晚上六点吃晚餐。
children.explanation: 句子明确说明“have dinner at 6:00”。

children.text: After that, I read with my parents for an hour.
children.cn: 晚饭后，我和父母一起阅读一小时。
children.notes: for an hour 持续一小时，for + 时间段。
children.statement: for an hour 表示动作持续了一个小时。
children.explanation: for 加时间段表示某动作或状态持续的时长。

children.text: That's an important part of my everyday life.
children.cn: 那是我日常生活中重要的组成部分。
children.notes: an important part 重要的一部分；everyday 为形容词，意为“日常的”。
children.statement: everyday 在这里是副词，表示“每天”。
children.explanation: everyday 是形容词，意为“日常的”；表示“每天”的副词词组是分开写的 every day。

children.text: Then I prepare my schoolbag for the next day.
children.cn: 然后我为第二天准备好书包。
children.notes: prepare... for... 为……准备……；the next day 第二天。
children.statement: prepare sth for 意思是“为……准备某物”。
children.explanation: prepare... for... 是固定搭配短语。

children.text: At 9:30, it's time for me to go to bed.
children.cn: 在9:30，到了我睡觉的时间了。
children.notes: It's time for sb to do sth 到某人做某事的时间了。
children.statement: It's time for me to go to bed 句型中，for 后面接宾格代词 me。
children.explanation: 介词 for 后面要用人称代词的宾格形式 me。
children.keywords: time for me, go to bed

tree.text: Reading Plus: Parents' Special Work Routines
tree.cn: 补充阅读：父母特殊的作息日常

children.text: My mother is a nurse in a hospital.
children.cn: 我妈妈是一家医院的护士。
children.notes: nurse 护士；in a hospital 在医院。
children.statement: 雯雯的妈妈是一名医生。
children.explanation: 雯雯的妈妈是护士（nurse），不是医生。

children.text: When she works at night, we eat dinner together at 6:30 p.m., and then she goes to work.
children.cn: 当她上夜班时，我们在下午6:30一起吃晚餐，然后她去上班。
children.notes: When 引导时间状语从句；work at night 上夜班。
children.statement: When 在此句中引导时间状语从句。
children.explanation: When 引导的从句表示“当……的时候”，为时间状语从句。
children.keywords: works at night, dinner, goes to work

children.notes: start 开始，相当于 begin。
children.statement: 雯雯妈妈的工作在晚上十点开始。
children.explanation: 句中说“Her work starts at 10:00”。

children.text: She checks on each patient every three hours.
children.cn: 她每隔三个小时查看一次每位病人。
children.notes: check on 查看/核实；every three hours 每三个小时；patient 病人。
children.statement: every three hours 表示“每隔三个小时”。
children.explanation: every + 基数词 + 复数名词，表示“每隔……”。
children.keywords: checks on, patient, every three hours

children.text: She finishes work at 8:00 a.m. the next day and arrives home by 9:00.
children.cn: 她在第二天早上8:00下班，并在9:00之前回到家。
children.notes: finishes work 下班；by 9:00 在九点前。
children.statement: by 9:00 意思是“在九点之前/不迟于九点”。
children.explanation: 介词 by 后加时间点表示“不迟于……；在……之前”。
children.keywords: finishes work, next day, arrives home

children.notes: bedtime 就寝时间；around 介词，大约。
children.statement: 雯雯妈妈在夜班后大约上午十点半睡觉。
children.explanation: 结合上下文，早晨九点到家后，上午 10:30 上床补觉。

children.text: She is busy with her work, but when she is free, we go to the park and have a good time together.
children.cn: 她工作很忙，但当她有空时，我们会去公园一起度过愉快时光。
children.notes: be busy with 忙于……；be free 有空；have a good time 玩得开心。
children.statement: be free 在句中意为“免费”。
children.explanation: be free 在句中表示人“空闲的，有空的”。
children.keywords: busy with, free, park, good time

children.cn: 科林的爸爸：环卫垃圾清运工

children.text: My father is a bin worker.
children.cn: 我爸爸是一名垃圾清理工。
children.notes: bin worker 垃圾清运工/环卫工；bin 垃圾箱。
children.statement: 科林的父亲从事环卫垃圾清运工作。
children.explanation: 原文明确写明“My father is a bin worker”。

children.text: I usually don't see him in the morning because he gets up at 4:00 a.m.
children.cn: 早上我通常见不到他，因为他凌晨4:00就起床了。
children.notes: because 引导原因状语从句，表示“因为”。
children.statement: Colin 早上看不到爸爸是因为爸爸起床非常早。
children.explanation: because he gets up at 4:00 a.m. 解释了原因。

children.text: He has something to eat and then goes to work.
children.cn: 他吃点东西，然后去上班。
children.notes: have something to eat 吃点东西（动词不定式作定语）。
children.statement: something to eat 中的 to eat 作后置定语修饰 something。
children.explanation: 不定式短语 to eat 放在不定代词 something 后作定语。
children.keywords: something to eat, goes to work

children.text: By 5:00, he is at his first house to empty rubbish bins into a lorry.
children.cn: 到5:00时，他已经在第一户人家那里将垃圾桶清空倒进卡车里了。
children.notes: empty 动词，清空；rubbish bins 垃圾桶；lorry 卡车。
children.statement: 句中的 empty 是形容词“空的”。
children.explanation: 这里的 empty 是动词，意为“倒空，清空”。

children.notes: ends 动词第三人称单数形式，意为结束。
children.statement: 爸爸的工作在下午三点左右结束。
children.explanation: 文中说明“Work ends around 3:00 p.m.”。

children.text: Then he comes to school to pick me up at 4:30.
children.notes: pick sb up 开车/顺道接某人。
children.statement: pick me up 意思是“来接我”。
children.explanation: pick up 代词作宾语时必须放在中间，即 pick me up。
children.keywords: comes to school, pick me up

children.text: We talk a lot on the way home.
children.cn: 在回家的路上我们聊很多话。
children.notes: on the way home 在回家路上；talk a lot 聊很多。
children.statement: on the way home 意为“在去学校的路上”。
children.explanation: on the way home 意为“在回家的路上”。
children.keywords: talk a lot, on the way home

children.notes: 简要表达用餐时间。
children.statement: 他们一家在六点吃晚饭。
children.explanation: 文中说明“Dinner is at 6:00”。

children.text: After dinner, he watches TV for a while.
children.cn: 晚饭后，他看一会儿电视。
children.notes: for a while 一会儿；watches TV 看电视。
children.statement: for a while 意思是“一会儿”。
children.explanation: for a while 是固定短语，表示“暂时；一会儿”。
children.keywords: after dinner, watches TV, a while

children.text: Then he goes to bed early at 8:30.
children.cn: 然后他早早在8:30上床睡觉。
children.notes: goes to bed early 早睡觉。
children.statement: 爸爸在晚上 8:30 睡觉。
children.explanation: 文中说明“goes to bed early at 8:30”。

children.text: We try to keep quiet at night so he sleeps well.
children.cn: 我们晚上尽量保持安静，以便他能睡个好觉。
children.notes: try to do sth 尽力做某事；keep quiet 保持安静；so 连词引导结果/目的。
children.statement: so 在这里作为连词，表示“因此/以便”。
children.explanation: so 连接因果或目的状语从句，使句子语义连贯。
